Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Full Stack Software Engineer werk je mee aan digitale toepassingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden door medewerkers en burgers in Antwerpen. Je ontwikkelt end-to-end oplossingen met directe maatschappelijke impact, van backend-services en API's tot gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces.

Je werkt nauw samen met architecten, analisten en andere ontwikkelaars aan moderne cloud-native toepassingen op Microsoft Azure. Daarbij denk je actief mee over performantie, beveiliging, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid op voor features van analyse tot productie en draagt bij aan een cultuur van continue verbetering en kennisdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwikkelen van moderne webapplicaties met .NET (C#) en Angular.
Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van REST API's en backend-services.
Realiseren van performante en gebruiksvriendelijke frontends.
Werken met Azure-cloudservices voor hosting, storage, security en deployment, waaronder Storage, RBAC, App Services en Virtual Machines.
Opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD-processen binnen Azure DevOps.
Werken met Git en versiebeheer binnen een professionele ontwikkelomgeving.
Toepassen van relationele databanken en SQL in de ontwikkeling van toepassingen.
Meewerken aan veilige softwareontwikkeling volgens security-by-design en DevSecOps-principes.
Bijdragen aan codekwaliteit, testing en technische keuzes rond softwarearchitectuur.
Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire Agile/Scrum-teams.
Meedenken in technische analyse en functionele afstemming met business stakeholders.
Ondersteunen van innovatie-initiatieven rond AI, machine learning, data-analyse en computer vision.
Actief bijdragen aan code reviews, kennisdeling en technische verbeteringen binnen het team.

Jouw profiel

Aantoonbare ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen.
Je hebt een aantoonbare opleiding met certificatie of gelijkwaardige ervaring in programmeertalen en omgevingen zoals .NET (C#) en ASP.NET.
Je voert programmeeropdrachten vlot en zelfstandig uit: coderen, testen en debuggen behoren tot je dagelijkse expertise.
Ervaring met Azure DevOps en CI/CD-processen is vereist.
Je hebt ervaring met frontendontwikkeling in Angular.
Je bent vertrouwd met Git en versiebeheer.
Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van REST API's.
Je werkt vlot met relationele databanken en SQL.
Je hebt kennis van Agile- en Scrum-methodologieën en ervaring met een Agile ontwikkelingsaanpak.
Je hebt aandacht voor softwarearchitectuur, codekwaliteit en testing.
Je beschikt over een bachelor Toegepaste Informatica of gelijkwaardige ervaring.
Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands; taalniveau C2 is vereist.
Ervaring met Microsoft Azure is belangrijk, met kennis van onder meer Storage, RBAC, App Services en Virtual Machines.
Kennis van Docker en containerisatie is een plus.
Ervaring met AI-, machine learning- of computer vision-projecten is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van React en/of andere moderne JavaScript-frameworks is een plus.
Ervaring met Java Spring Boot is een bijkomende troef.
Kennis van cloudplatformen zoals AWS is een pluspunt.
Affiniteit met UX/UI-design, Figma en UML-modellering is meegenomen.
Je hebt voeling met informatieveiligheid, bijvoorbeeld via DevSecOps-principes of kaders zoals ISO 27001.
Je bent resultaatgericht, pragmatisch, analytisch sterk en denkt oplossingsgericht.
Je bent leergierig, werkt graag samen en deelt actief kennis met collega's.
Je neemt ownership op en hebt oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en gebruiksvriendelijkheid.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.title: Specialist, MSAT Manufacturing Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Bristol Myers Squibb Netherlands

Bristol Myers Squibb has been active in the Dutch market for over 50 years, employing people across a range of activities and business units in Utrecht, The Netherlands.

The Netherlands is also home to our first European Cell Therapy facility, located at the Leiden Bio Science Park, the largest life sciences cluster of The Netherlands. This new state of the art facility is focused on commercial manufacturing with capabilities for multi-product Cell Therapy manufacturing. You can become part of this exciting journey. Check out this video if you want to know more about it!

The Netherlands has everything it takes to become the medicines hub of Europe, the so-called Boston by the North Sea. As we continue to expand our footprint by building this new site, we are looking to grow our team.

Would you like to become an important chain in our worldwide network to bring this new personalized treatment to patients suffering from blood cancer? Join us and be a game changer!

For more information about Bristol Myers Squibb Netherlands, visit us at bms.com/nl or careers.bms.com/nl

Position Summary

This function supports the solution intake and design, delivery, operational support, continuous improvement, change management, and lifecycle for the site manufacturing execution system (MES) and associated boundary systems used in the production of cell therapy products.

Duties/Responsibilities

Support consistent execution of MES recipe modifications, change controls, and adherence to governing documents related to change management.
Engage with Site teams (Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Shared Services, etc.) to support and improve capacity, quality, and cost or to establish root cause.
Work closely with end users/process owners and subject matter experts to maintain service level expectations across all functions and site systems.
Work with site functional teams, including manufacturing, engineering, warehouse, and quality assurance to gather user requirements for recipe development.
Provide on-the-floor or remote process support for ongoing manufacturing activities when needed.
Participate in delivering critical improvements across the manufacturing network through digital technology (e.g., EBR) updates and technical insight.
Provide MES product impact assessments to support change management, investigations, and product release.
Develop inputs into electronic batch record/process automation technologies to advance digital manufacturing strategy.
Lead or assist in designing, testing, and maintaining Electronic Batch Records and related manufacturing data, including, but not limited to, specifications, process parameters, recipes, routings, formulas, process instructions, and process variables.
Ensuring Recipes/MES are configured for intended use per business requirements and applicable procedures throughout the recipes and MES system lifecycle from design to implementation.
Support lifecycle management project implementation at a site level to accomplish drug product harmonization across sites and evolve the process.
Translate business requirements into functional and design specifications that are compliant, efficient, and effective.
Support the change initiatives and the implementation of process improvement initiatives.
Interface with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, IT, MSAT groups, etc., and serve as applicable Manufacturing System Business Owner.
Perform process monitoring initiatives, including but not limited to developing and collecting data, analyzing and optimizing the end-to-end process, and anticipating and permanently resolving issues that may arise during production.
Continuously integrates with the business to understand current business processes and to provide technology guidance that enables and supports Digital Plant plans and strategies.
Support Technical Product Team, Validation, Development, Operations, QA, and Regulatory in the area of expertise.

Qualifications

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Proven experience in building, testing, deployment and maintain and support systems MES (preferably Emerson Syncade), eBR, DeltaV in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
Proven experience in cGMP/GMP, ICH guidelines, data integrity, computer system validation and IQ/OQ/PQ of the equipment
Capable of exercising sound judgment while adapting to rapidly changing priorities
Demonstrated ability to work in a matrixed structure; focused strongly on stakeholder service and personnel growth.
Excellent written and presentations skills

Education/Experience/ Licenses/Certifications

Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
Advanced degree preferred.
5+ years of relevant work experience is required, preferably in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical or related industry.
Understanding cell culture, cryopreservation, purification, aseptic processing or lab technique, Packaging, Shop floor quality, batch review, or disposition preferred.
Experience with MES, ERP, DCS, SCADA, LIMS, or other manufacturing and automation boundary systems and technologies preferred.
Experience with electronic validation systems (Valgenesis)
Experience with quality management systems (Veeva vault, Trackwise etc.)

Disclaimer: For any third parties or external agencies, please, be informed we do not accept unsolicited requests, proposals, applications or profiles for any of our roles at BMS.

Why You Should Apply

Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives.

jobs.title: AI Platform engineer
jobs.description:
Career at WUR

About Us

Plenty of variety and challenges
Pleasant working atmosphere
Time for personal development
Proper work-life balance
Internationally leading

Your job

Within WUR, we are setting up our own chatAI environment in which our users (students, teachers, researchers) can use the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence for research and education safely and within established guardrails. This includes the WUR AI Chat, the WUR LLM Hub and integrations with internal data sources.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will be part of an ambitious and technically strong team that is responsible for developing and maintaining our WUR AI Facility. You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

Your team

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. Collaboration, communication, transparency and continuous feedback are essential. You will work on campus at least two days a week and can choose to work partly from home as well, for good focus and a healthy work-life balance.

You will work here

You will work in a professional IT organization with more than 200 IT specialists where you can learn a lot and develop yourself well. We have two of our own data centers on our beautiful, green and spacious campus and we are committed to digital sovereignty, the use of open source solutions and a sustainable use of our environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technology in the field of Artificial Intelligence and the infrastructure used for this.

Your qualities

You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. You are a connector and dare to speak out and ask questions. You are a real go-getter, have strong communication skills and have a warm heart for education and research. In addition, you are analytically minded but also solution- and customer-oriented. You are enterprising and have the drive and organizational talent to get things done as a driving force. You are creative and always look for new solutions to make existing environments more effective and new functionalities possible. You also have a good eye for the availability, stability, scalability and user-friendliness of the infrastructure provided.

You Also Possess

HBO working and thinking level, preferably through a completed HBO ICT education;
experience as a System Administrator or DevOps Engineer in an enterprise environment;
knowledge of and experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments and Azure cloud solutions;
knowledge of designing and managing cloud-native concepts;
experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and a declarative mindset;
experience with containerization and CI/CD tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Git(lab));
basic knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as Python or Bash;
a good command of Dutch and English. The working language within the IT organization is Dutch, but in our international working environment, more and more communication is in English.

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment . A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

Of course, these excellent fringe benefits also include an appropriate salary. Depending on your experience, we offer a salary of a minimum of € 3,554.- to a maximum of € 6,471.- for a full working week of 36 hours according to Collective Labor Agreement Wageningen Research (scale 10/11). For this role, an appointment of 32 hours is also negotiable. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the intention of converting it to an indefinite contract

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, in an international and open working atmosphere.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract is the starting point. Ask your HR Business Partner about your situation specifically.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center . This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Roy Bartels (Department Manager) via email: roy.bartels@wur.nl.

Questions about the procedure? Please contact Edvard Jongschaap, Sr Corporate Recruiter, via email: edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl or by phone: +31 371 – 489 178.

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button for the vacancy on our website. Only applications via our website will be processed.

You can respond until Monday, November 2, 2026
. The first interviews are scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026. Preferably, internal candidates apply before October 2, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. It is therefore possible that the vacancy has been filled earlier than the stated closing date.

Screening policy
.

Submitting a valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and requesting references are part of the application procedure.

Procedure

Within our selection procedure, an assessment of working and thinking level can be included as part of the process.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Rolle und Aufgaben

Entwicklung leistungsstarker Versicherungssysteme für Millionen von Kundenanfragen, mit Fokus auf Vertriebslösungen für Vermittler, Telefonagenten, Makler, Partner und Direktkunden im hybriden Vertriebsmodell der ERGO
Mitgestaltung moderner Softwarearchitekturen, inklusive Microservices und Cloud-Infrastrukturen, mit Verantwortung für Stabilität, Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit der Systeme
Sicherstellung hoher Softwarequalität durch frühzeitige Fehlererkennung, Analyse von Schwachstellen und kontinuierliche Optimierung für robuste, sichere und performante Anwendungen
Förderung von technologischer Innovation durch Einsatz moderner Technologien, experimentelle Ansätze und Einbringung frischer Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Landschaft
Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen, vielfältigen Team mit Business Analysten, Test Managern und weiteren Stakeholdern zur kreativen Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen

Profil und Qualifikationen

Akademischer Hintergrund oder mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in Informatik, Versicherungswesen oder vergleichbaren Fachgebieten, mit solide verankertem Praxiswissen
Methodische Kompetenz in agilen Entwicklungsmethoden (Scrum, Kanban), DevOps Praktiken sowie Engineering Konzepten wie Testautomatisierung und Infrastructure as Code
Technische Stärke in C#, .NET 8 (Verständnis .NET 4.8 Webforms wünschenswert), API-Entwicklung (WCF/REST), SQL Server, HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Angular/React/NodeJS), Secure Programming, SAML, Cloud-Technologien, Containerisierung von .NET Anwendungen, VS2022 und Azure
Lösungsorientiertes Denken mit strukturierter Analyse komplexer Probleme, Identifikation von Kernherausforderungen und Entwicklung smarter, ganzheitlicher Lösungen
Wachstumsmentalität mit klarer Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, Freude an internationaler Zusammenarbeit, Lernbereitschaft für neue Technologien und Motivation, gemeinsam Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln

Angebot und Rahmenbedingungen

Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit innovativem Handlungsspielraum

Wir bieten Ihnen aber noch viel mehr: Freuen Sie sich auf eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre und eine wertschätzende Kultur der Zusammenarbeit. Wachsen Sie mit uns: Mit maßgeschneiderten Fort- und Weiterbildungen fördern wir Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Moderne Technik und flexibles mobiles Arbeiten geben Ihnen einen individuellen Freiraum.

ITERGO bietet Ihnen die Entwicklungsperspektiven eines großen Konzerns und dessen Sicherheit. Zusätzlich zu einem attraktiven Gehaltspaket genießen Sie überdurchschnittliche Sozial- und Gesundheitsservices. Unser Standort Düsseldorf in günstiger Lage bietet Ihnen eine gute Infrastruktur.

Über uns

An vier Standorten entwirft, realisiert und löst ITERGO alle IT-Anforderungen für etwa 36.000 Anwender im Innen- und Außendienst. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine einheitliche, konzernweite Systemlandschaft. Wir bieten ein dynamisches Umfeld und anspruchsvolle Aufgaben in vielseitigen Projekten – an denen Sie weiter wachsen können.

Gemeinsam wachsen

Bei ITERGO erleben Sie gelebte Vielfalt und haben die Chance, mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Fachbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten. Ihren Entwicklungsweg gestalten Sie selbst – mit Seminaren, Programmen, Netzwerkformaten, Sprachkursen, E‑Learnings und Lernen im Job. Unsere starken nationalen und internationalen Strukturen eröffnen Ihnen dafür vielfältige und flexible Karrierewege.

Bewerbungsfrist

Keine. So lange diese Stellenanzeige online ist, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.

jobs.title: Software Entwickler (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Gelsenkirchen

Was wir leisten!

Die VTA Software & Service GmbH steht für fortschrittliche IT-Lösungen, die Nachhaltigkeit, Effizienz und Innovation vereinen. Als Experten in den Bereichen Energiewirtschaft, Logistik und chemische Industrie entwickeln wir individuelle Lösungen, die Prozesse automatisieren, Kosten reduzieren und gleichzeitig Umweltziele erreichen. Unser Ziel ist es,

Unternehmen bei der Reduktion von CO -Emissionen zu unterstützen, die Nachhaltigkeit ihrer Produkte zu dokumentieren und ressourcenschonende Logistikprozesse zu ermöglichen.

Was uns auszeichnet

Wir setzen nicht nur auf bewährte Standards, sondern schaffen durch innovative Ideen immer wieder neue Lösungen, um unsere Kunden voranzubringen. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen bei der Gestaltung effizienter und transparenter Geschäftsabläufe zu unterstützen – technisch wie fachlich und mit einem geschulten Blick auf das Thema

Sicherheit. Wir betreiben viele unserer selbst entwickelten Produkte als SaaS aus der Cloud in einem nach ISO/IEC 27001 zertifizierten Rahmen und gehören zur kritischen Infrastruktur in Deutschland.

Aufgaben

Mitgestaltung von Architektur und Konzeption der zu entwickelnden Web- und Mobile-Applikationen als Mitglied eines ganzheitlich denkenden und agilen Entwicklungsteams.
Begleitung der gesamten Entwicklung – Konzeption, Design, Implementierung, Dokumentation, Test & Deployment.
(Weiter-) Entwicklung, Wartung und Pflege unserer eigenen Softwarelösung CEEMAS.
Qualitätssicherung der Software durch automatisierte Tests in Front- und Backend.
Unterstützung der Kunden bei Fragen rund um das Produkt.

Anforderungen

Studium der Informatik, eine Ausbildung in diesem Bereich oder ähnliche Qualifikation.
Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webapplikationen, Erfahrung in agiler Teamarbeit.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Programmiersprachen C# und TypeScript/JavaScript, in Software-Entwicklungstools und -prozessen sowie Frameworks (z. B. VueJs, Azure Dev Ops) und Datenbanken (SQL z. B. Oracle, H2 …).
Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Testframeworks (z. B. Cypress), Erfahrung mit der Test-Erstellung auf allen Ebenen.
Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit CI/CD, Versionierung mit Git und REST-Schnittstellen.
Bereitschaft zur ständigen Weiterentwicklung, offen für wechselnde und wachsende Anforderungen.
Kundenorientierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise, gute Teamfähigkeit sowie analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was Wir Bieten

Wertschätzung und Unterstützung für Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
Ein erfahrener Coach/Mentor steht Dir in der Anfangszeit und darüber hinaus bei Deinen Projekten zur Seite.
Attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütungsstrukturen.
Unbefristete Festanstellung & einen zukunftssicheren Arbeitsplatz.
Moderne Arbeitsformen, die Flexibilität schaffen und engagiertes Arbeiten fördern.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Benefits wie JobRad, Fitness-Zuschuss, Mitarbeiterrabatte & mehr.
Positives Arbeitsumfeld – überzeug Dich auf kununu: https://www.kununu.com/de/vta-software-service.
Eine moderne Kantine für eine gesellige Mittagspause und gemeinsamen Austausch.

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung als Software Entwickler (m/w/d).

Solltest Du Fragen im Vorfeld haben oder einen ersten vertraulichen Kontakt wünschen, steht Dir Valeska Kölsch gerne zur Verfügung.
